protocol: Each of the 300 corpus intents is submitted to the production capabilities_search (limit 3, no artifact filter). A hit requires an Operation ID bound to the intent's major requirement in catalog/major_requirements.json to be returned (top-1: first).
provenance: The corpus is a checked-in authored development corpus; it was not frozen before routing work.
Vocabulary changes after the baseline were derived from development-split misses only.
The baseline miss list (ids and expected Operations) was visible for every split, so held_out is a weak, not a blind, estimate.
Blind generalization is reported separately in docs/master/evidence/search-blind.json (118 intents written from operation documentation, measured once after tuning was frozen).
No per-query or Operation-ID string is hardcoded in search.py.

automatic_execution.reason: Goal routing never calls execute; execution is measured separately in execute_after_search_sample

execute_after_search_sample.selection_rule: every intent whose goal routes to its expected operation at top-1
execute_after_search_sample.scope: all auto-routed intents; disambiguated or refused intents are not executed
